source.name: FootyLogos — Sabah FK 2026-27 Home & Away kits
source.note: Kit-information table for the 2026-27 UEFA Champions League collection lists 'Kit supplier Nike' and 'Front sponsor Bank Respublika', and the home-kit text repeats it. Independent corroboration: FootballKitArchive's Sabah FC (AZ) 2026-27 home-kits page states 'Made by Nike, the Sabah FC (AZ) 2026-27 home kit features Bank Respublika as the main sponsor' (page behind Cloudflare, snippet verified via search). Bank Respublika has been Sabah's shirt sponsor since 2019/20, most recently renewed in July 2022 (marja.az, 7 Jul 2022: 'Müqaviləyə əsasən, “Sabah” FK ... 2022/2023-cü illər mövsümündə keçirdiyi bütün oyunlarda "Bank Respublika"ya məxsus əmtəə nişanları olan formalarda çıxış edəcək').
source.quote: The shirt is made by Nike and carries Bank Respublika on the front.

source.name: Footy Headlines — Champions League Debut: Sabah FC 26-27 Kits - Carried Over for Multiple Seasons
source.note: Kit maker, recorded as partner per existing convention. FootyLogos' 2026-27 kit-information table lists 'Kit supplier Nike'. The black home shirt is carried over for an unprecedented fourth consecutive season; both shirts are based on the standard Nike Vapor IV 23-24 teamwear template.
source.quote: Sabah FC's black home kit is being worn for an unprecedented fourth consecutive season

source.name: Sabah FK — “Sabah” FK “Scorpio Group”la sponsorluq müqaviləsi imzalayıb
source.note: The club announced on 5 September 2026 that Scorpio Group signed a sponsorship agreement and will be the club's 'texniki sponsoru' (technical sponsor). Nike remains the 2026-27 kit supplier (FootyLogos/Footy Headlines), so 'technical sponsor' here is a partnership role, not the shirt maker; no Scorpio shirt placement is claimed and no Scorpio logo placement is documented, so it is filed as a partner.
source.quote: “Sabah” Futbol Klubu beynəlxalq “Scorpio Group” şirkəti ilə sponsorluq müqaviləsi imzalayıb. Əldə olunan razılaşmaya əsasən, “Scorpio Group” klubumuzun texniki sponsoru olacaq.

summary: Nike home shirt (the black template carried over for a fourth straight season) with Bank Respublika on the front. No back, sleeve or shorts sponsor is named by any source checked, and the club's own site publishes only a partners page without shirt placements, so the sponsor list is not marked complete. Scorpio Group became the club's technical sponsor on 5 September 2026; its role is a partnership, since Nike supplies the shirts.
